en.title: Whaaat AI or Sintra: named marketing agents for small teams
en.metaTitle: Whaaat AI vs Sintra (2026): prices, credits, agents, hosting, limits
en.description: Whaaat AI (Berlin) vs Sintra: $25 unlimited or credit plans, 28 marketing agents vs 12 helpers, data hosting and real limits. Checked August 2026.
en.intro: Whaaat AI is a Berlin platform with 28 named marketing agents (Lin for LinkedIn, Bob for blogs, Sepp for SEO articles) that share one brand knowledge base, for $25 a month with unlimited use. Sintra bundles 12 named helpers across marketing, support, sales and admin on a discounted subscription with 250 credits a month. The deciding difference: Whaaat is marketing-only and unmetered; Sintra is broader but metered.
glance: Who it is for
Small marketing teams, startups and agencies that publish across many channels
Solo founders and small businesses that want one helper each for social, copy, support, sales and admin
What you get
28 channel-specific content agents, shared brand knowledge base, brand presets per client, image generation via FLUX
12 helpers with a shared 'Brain', 15+ integrations (Gmail, Notion, Shopify, QuickBooks), image generation
Price per user
$25/month, unlimited use of all agents (single price; seat model not published)
List $97/month; sold at $48.50 monthly, $23.60 on 3 months, $15.60 on 12 months (as of 26 Aug 2026). Single helper $39/month
Free plan or trial
7-day free trial, full access to all agents
No free plan; 14-day money-back guarantee
EU hosting
Not published. Company is UFOstart GmbH, Berlin; models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral
Not EU. Entity PlayOS, Inc. (Delaware); data may be processed in the US
Team features
Multi-client brand presets; team seats not published
Unlimited workspaces; no per-seat plan or team admin
Build your own agents
No; preconfigured agents only
No; fixed helper personas with configurable automations
Credits
None; unlimited stated
250 credits per month on every plan; top-ups extra; no rollover

pickA.heading: Pick Whaaat AI if…
points: Your need is marketing content across many channels and you want one flat price with no meter.
You run several brands or clients and want presets per brand.
You prefer a German vendor with a Berlin address, even though hosting details are not yet published.

pickB.heading: Pick Sintra if…
points: You need helpers beyond marketing: support, sales, bookkeeping, recruiting.
You want integrations with Gmail, Notion or Shopify inside the helper chat.
You can accept credits and US processing for a low promo price.

a: No published hosting region, GDPR statement or team seat model on the site; a ~12-person startup that closed a seed round in 2026 (ADZINE, June 2026). Ask before buying.
Agents produce content; the site lists no publishing or scheduling integrations, so posting still happens elsewhere.
b: Credits: 250 a month on every plan; image and data tasks drain them fast, and Trustpilot suspended Sintra's score over review incentives while recent reviews cite credit burn (uk.trustpilot.com, Aug 2026).
Helpers do not execute: no auto-posting, sending or CRM updates; no helpdesk integrations such as Zendesk (eesel review, 17 Jul 2026).

en.verdict: For a small marketing team that only wants content, Whaaat AI is simpler and cheaper to run: $25, no credits, marketing-only. Sintra suits a solo founder who needs a support or sales helper too and can manage credits. On data protection, neither publishes an EU hosting fact today; Whaaat is at least a German legal entity.

bridge.heading: If you want the work done, not a chat window
bridge.text: Both tools above give one person named agents to chat with. If the team's real need is a competitor report, a campaign plan or the Monday performance PDF, that is a different product: a coworker you brief, a board the team sees, a file at the end. Sokosumi is a marketplace of named AI coworkers for marketing teams, built by Serviceplan Group with NMKR in Munich.
points: 52 coworkers and agents from 7 vendors; each profile names the vendor, the models and the hosting, with EU hosting available.
Free: 250 credits per seat per month, no card. Paid seats €25, €75 or €200 per month; credits are used only when a task runs.
Tasks show on a shared board and end with a finished PDF, deck, spreadsheet or dashboard.

faq: The site says $25 a month for unlimited use of all agents and all models. It does not publish a fair-use policy; ask if you plan very heavy use.
UFOstart GmbH in Berlin, founded by Lars Schulze and Thomas Hessler, about 12 staff, seed-funded (ADZINE, June 2026).
Sintra's privacy policy names PlayOS, Inc. in Delaware and says data may be processed in the US, with OpenAI, Google and Anthropic as AI providers.
Which one delivers a finished campaign plan as a file?
Both return text and images in a chat. Neither runs a shared task board with file deliverables; Sokosumi coworkers are built for that.
